nightlyRechargeResults.sleepTip: You were awake a lot last night. Have you been feeling sore or tense? Try to relieve tension by doing some relaxing exercises like stretching before bedtime, or take a comforting warm shower.
nightlyRechargeResults.vitalityTip: Stay sharp and awake during the day by keeping hydrated. Drink fluids and eat water-rich foods. Dehydration can make you feel fatigued and cause a headache.
nightlyRechargeResults.exerciseTip: You can train today. However, you've trained a lot lately so pay attention to how you feel.
